independent_review_findings.problem: Absolute descriptor paths would differ after the native runner stages the project.
independent_review_findings.resolution: Freeze canonical project-relative descriptor arguments and recompute the complete contract in the staged workspace without changing the already request-pinned control_scoring.py.

independent_review_findings.problem: The equivalence contract did not self-contain the request, population and three prediction/report identities.
independent_review_findings.resolution: Bind request ref and digest, population ref, and ordered report/prediction refs in both the sample manifest and equivalence contract.

independent_review_findings.problem: Copying only the verification sidecar would leave its record and raw-output refs unresolved.
independent_review_findings.resolution: Mark complete-bundle promotion as mandatory and require byte-for-byte promotion to the exact project-relative target plus hash revalidation.

independent_review_findings.problem: The Local sequence still placed the unavailable scientific protocol before executable engineering parity.
independent_review_findings.resolution: Run engineering parity first; retain the scientific protocol blocker after parity rather than using it to skip equivalence measurement.

independent_review_findings.problem: The staging-stable canonical descriptor was not the absolute faithful command required by the unchanged later scientific admission.
independent_review_findings.resolution: Emit only a canonical bundle attestation during parity; after complete promotion, the finalizer uses unchanged contract_scorer_command to create the exact scientific-consumer descriptor.

independent_review_findings.problem: Promotion was documented but not enforced before the consumer sidecar could be used.
independent_review_findings.resolution: The consumer sidecar is absent from harness outputs and is single-use generated only at the exact stable target after resolving all bundle hashes.

independent_review_findings.problem: Frozen inputs were not rechecked after six scorer subprocesses.
independent_review_findings.resolution: Recompute the contract and resolve every frozen request, population, GT, arm, source/code, manifest and environment ref immediately before pass status and attestation.

independent_review_findings.problem: A promoted bundle could be internally consistent without proving origin from the approved completed harness attempt.
independent_review_findings.resolution: Finalization now verifies the approved harness digest, completed harness report, native plan/receipt, exact engineering attempt/input/code/output inventory and receipt-recorded hashes before consumer sidecar creation.

independent_review_findings.problem: Pre-promotion evidence called its attestation a completed sidecar.
independent_review_findings.resolution: Evidence now records bundle_attestation_status and explicitly marks consumer verification pending promotion and finalization.

fail_closed_boundary: contract rejects all baseline/control qualification fields, criteria, contrasts and effect thresholds
exact returned request, released population, GT, source review, environment and three arm artifacts are hash-bound
runtime interpreter, five package versions, physical GPU UUID and CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES must match
all three official and faithful paths must pass full provenance validation before zero-tolerance comparison
passed consumer sidecar is scoped to the exact manifest and complete promoted bundle
no official score, baseline/control decision, candidate result or scientific gate is produced
final_independent_static_review: no remaining critical or important runtime admission issue
